primary_intent: Estimate net pay from gross income
notes: User problem: gross salary, country, pay period, pension/student loan/state options. Inputs: annual/monthly/weekly net, effective deduction rate. Outputs: Different core problem from static salary pages; flagship V2 entry point.

primary_intent: Calculate income tax separately from total take-home pay
notes: User problem: gross income, country, tax year, filing/status options. Inputs: income tax estimate, taxable income, marginal/effective rate. Outputs: Distinct from take-home pay because it isolates income tax.

primary_intent: Understand UK NI deduction from earnings
notes: User problem: salary, employment class, tax year. Inputs: employee NI estimate, monthly/weekly equivalent. Outputs: UK-specific statutory deduction with strong calculator intent.

primary_intent: Estimate UK student loan payroll deductions
notes: User problem: salary, plan type, postgraduate flag. Inputs: annual/monthly repayment estimate. Outputs: Distinct deduction users actively search for.

primary_intent: Estimate take-home from a one-off bonus
notes: User problem: salary, bonus, country, pension assumptions. Inputs: estimated retained bonus, tax impact. Outputs: Bonus behaves differently from normal monthly pay in user perception.

primary_intent: Estimate whether extra hours are worth it after deductions
notes: User problem: base pay, hourly rate, overtime hours, country. Inputs: gross overtime, net overtime, real hourly value. Outputs: Distinct work/pay calculation with high practical value.

primary_intent: Estimate take-home impact of pension contributions
notes: User problem: salary, employee %, employer %, relief style. Inputs: take-home change, contribution totals. Outputs: Strong pay deduction tool, educational not advice.

primary_intent: Model salary sacrifice impact on net pay
notes: User problem: salary, sacrifice amount, pension/benefit type. Inputs: gross reduction, tax/NI effect, net change. Outputs: Distinct statutory/payroll planning calculation.
User problem: loan amount, rate, term, repayment type. Inputs: monthly payment, interest estimate. Outputs: Clear broad calculator intent and portfolio bridge to CreditRoadmap.
User problem: amount, APR/rate, term. Inputs: monthly repayment, total interest. Outputs: Core money calculator distinct from credit advice.
User problem: balance, APR, payment. Inputs: months to clear, interest paid. Outputs: Useful decision tool without regulated advice.
User problem: income, rent, bills, debt, savings. Inputs: monthly surplus/deficit, category shares. Outputs: Natural broad money platform page.

primary_intent: Estimate affordable rent from take-home pay
notes: User problem: monthly income, debts, target ratio. Inputs: rent range, leftover income. Outputs: Strong link from salary/take-home to housing.
User problem: distance, days, fare/fuel/parking/time. Inputs: monthly cost, annual cost, salary equivalent. Outputs: Distinct from WorthMyTime if focused on money not time value.

primary_intent: Check if a higher salary offsets new costs
notes: User problem: current salary, offer, commute, pension, costs. Inputs: net gain/loss, break-even salary. Outputs: Excellent V2 decision calculator, portfolio bridge.
User problem: starting amount, contribution, rate, term. Inputs: future value, interest earned. Outputs: Classic useful calculator, not salary duplicate.
User problem: monthly expenses, months, current savings. Inputs: target, gap, time to target. Outputs: Natural household money utility.
User problem: loan amount, fees, payment, term. Inputs: APR/interest interpretation. Outputs: Useful but compliance wording needed.
User problem: credit limit, balance. Inputs: utilisation %. Outputs: Useful bridge, but CreditRoadmap may own deeper credit education.

primary_intent: Estimate interest/time saved by overpaying mortgage
notes: User problem: balance, rate, term, overpayment. Inputs: interest saved, months reduced. Outputs: High utility but must avoid advice.
User problem: income, housing, transport, bills, region optional. Inputs: monthly budget impact. Outputs: Useful but location data can sprawl if unchecked.
User problem: usage, rate, standing charge. Inputs: monthly/yearly cost. Outputs: Clear household utility, data changes often.

primary_intent: Estimate childcare cost against take-home pay
notes: User problem: fees, days, income, support optional. Inputs: monthly cost, income share. Outputs: High user value, policy complexity.

primary_intent: Spread council tax into budget view
notes: User problem: annual bill, months paid. Inputs: monthly cost, annual burden. Outputs: Useful but thin unless paired with budget context.
User problem: insurance, fuel, tax, maintenance, finance. Inputs: monthly/yearly total. Outputs: Strong household affordability bridge.
User problem: miles, MPG/kWh, fuel price. Inputs: trip/month/year cost. Outputs: Useful but commodity-data changes.
User problem: amount, inflation rate, years. Inputs: real value, price equivalent. Outputs: Useful topical evergreen.
User problem: target, timeframe, current savings. Inputs: monthly contribution required. Outputs: Clear tool intent.
User problem: monthly amount, rate, term. Inputs: future value. Outputs: Distinct from compound interest by contribution framing.
User problem: contribution, allowance, tax year. Inputs: remaining allowance. Outputs: UK-specific, annual limit dependent.
User problem: balance, contributions, return, years. Inputs: projected value. Outputs: Risk of investment-advice framing.
User problem: age, service, weekly pay. Inputs: statutory redundancy estimate. Outputs: Distinct UK statutory calculator.
User problem: days, hours, rate, salary. Inputs: holiday pay estimate. Outputs: Useful payroll/employment calculator.
User problem: days/weeks off, eligibility basics. Inputs: SSP estimate. Outputs: Useful but requires careful eligibility disclaimers.
User problem: weekly pay, dates, entitlement. Inputs: weekly/monthly estimate. Outputs: High complexity but high user value.
User problem: weekly pay, leave weeks. Inputs: pay estimate. Outputs: Useful but narrower demand.

primary_intent: Convert day rate to salary equivalent
notes: User problem: day rate, billable days, costs. Inputs: gross/net equivalent. Outputs: Useful contractor tool; avoid tax-advice detail.
User problem: day rate, days, pension, tax year. Inputs: net estimate. Outputs: High value, high complexity/compliance.
User problem: rate, days, salary/dividend assumptions. Inputs: illustrative take-home. Outputs: High risk of advice/complexity.
User problem: base rate, premium, shifts. Inputs: gross/net added pay. Outputs: Distinct work-pay calculator.
User problem: salary, notice length. Inputs: gross/pay-period value. Outputs: Useful but employment-law edges.
User problem: balance, fee, promo rate, term. Inputs: cost comparison. Outputs: Commercially useful, credit overlap.
